title: Finite bit construction: multi-write shear programs for all ten R439 phase-B blocks (24,305 -> 24,053 ADDs, no new kappa)
body:
**Status: finite bit-circuit construction; no new kappa.** One deterministic search in the full multi-write shear class replaces every phase-B block of the pinned [PR 589](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/589) tuned R439 word with a shorter exact program on the same registers at the same frame. The complete exported local word falls **24,305 -> 24,053 ADDs** (388 -> 262 block gates, 252 complete ADDs with literal reverse cleanup).

| quantity | before | after |
|---|---:|---:|
| phase-B block gates (all ten) | 388 | 262 |
| complete ADD records | 24,305 | 24,053 |
| forward positive bound | 49,347 | 26,653 |
| composed reverse positive bound | 1,113,070 | 776,006 |
| local payload | 93 bits | 90 bits (cap 104) |
| paid profile / rank mass | {1:1323, 2:1342, 3:79, 4:44, 5:102, 6:11, 7:19} / 5,129 | unchanged |
| kappa | complex-bound at base | unchanged |

Per-block (word -> this search -> best previously recorded): 506 26->21 (#891 class min 24; [PR 1001](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1001) also 21), 507 35->24 ([PR 880](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/880) 30; [PR 884](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/884)'s README's unpublished 24-gate hint matched), 519 42->27 ([PR 908](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/908) 32), 508 37->21 (#873/#891 30), 520 41->37 ([PR 923](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/923) claims 29 - **not beaten here**), 509 31->21 ([PR 973](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/973) also 21), 521 47->30 ([PR 884](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/884) 31), 522 43->29 ([PR 906](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/906) 33), 523 45->26 (#891 39, [PR 857](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/857) 40), 524 41->26 ([PR 914](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/914) 27).

**Class and coverage.** A block replacement is exactly a legal nonnegative row/column subtraction path from the block's integer transfer matrix to the identity; the class is all multi-write shear programs on the block's own registers (shared intermediates included), strictly containing #891's single-write class and [PR 880](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/880)'s fixed splits. `search.py` runs per block: 6,000 min-excess greedy reductions with random tie-breaks, 4,000 uniform random legal trajectories (cap 90), one width-6,000 beam below the incumbent. Seeds `20261013+frame`; all trials complete; no adaptive stopping. **Best found is not a minimality result** for any block.

**Reproduce** (stdlib Python 3.11+, ~2 min):

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r439-bsection-multwrite/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_R439_BSECTION_MULTWRITE gates=388->262 ADDs=24305->24053 columns=661 controls=8 rank_mass=5129 kappa=unchanged`. `search.py` regenerates `CANDIDATE.json` byte for byte (SHA-256 `771F980643402EB44B25312923B376A952E9C8ABB55796CBDC348BA51FC62728`, confirmed across two full runs). The verifier imports no search code: source pins, per-block integer maps and 2^10-2^12 Boolean truth tables, ten-way splice with literal cleanup, all 661 dirty-input endpoint columns, H1-H5 via the pinned `xcheck_p.py`, paid profile/rank mass, exporter bills and bounds via the pinned `export_records.py`, and eight rejected mutation controls. Exact report pinned in `CERTIFICATE.json`.

**Overlap (refreshed at submission).** [PR 1001](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1001) (506@21) and [PR 973](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/973) (509@21) independently reach two of these counts - convergent evidence, credited. [PR 989](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/989) composes four blocks (507/508/519/524) at 24,233 ADDs; this search's programs on those frames (24/21/27/26) are strictly shorter than what it composes (30/30/32/27) and this word covers all ten blocks. [PR 923](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/923)'s frame-520 program (29) is stronger than this search's 37 and is not imported. The phase-A prefix line ([PR 904](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/904)/[PR 936](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/936)/[PR 952](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/952)/[PR 980](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/980)) and the D-prefix substitution candidates ([PR 915](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/915)/[PR 926](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/926)/[PR 941](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/941)) are different mechanisms, not composed. No concurrent implementation is used.

**Scope.** Only `research/r439-bsection-multwrite/` is added; `upstream/`, the selected record and all consumed sources are unchanged (base `007664306fff84fbb1c9a1b4053b69f439764034`, pins in `SOURCES.json`). Conditional finite construction: native 5/9/11-stage replays, hosted invoice, supplier binding, outer assembly, Lean and remote CI are not run here; all inherited all-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source, whole-call hosting, precision/tape and analytic assumptions remain. The spliced word is a research witness, not a proposed frontier. Sprint claim, method, seed (16, bit-supplier track) and development defects are recorded in `CLAIM.md`/`VALIDATION.md`.
